name: JL Solar
old_description: Welcome to JL Solar, your reliable partner in electrical services, solar installations, and EV charger installations. We are committed to providing high-quality solutions that harness the power of renewable energy, ensuring a sustainable future for our customers and the environment. With a team of experienced professionals, we specialize in designing and implementing tailored solar systems and electric vehicle charging infrastructure. At JL Solar, we prioritize innovation, efficiency, and customer satisfaction as we work to meet your energy needs.
about:
JL Solar is a family-owned electrical company based in Odessa, Missouri, serving the Midwest with a focus on renewable energy solutions. The business is led by Shawna Lockwood as chief executive officer and James Lockwood, a master electrician with more than 25 years of experience, who serves as director of operations. Founded on family values, the company began with a commitment to personalized service and clean energy installations for residential and commercial clients.

The company designs and installs solar photovoltaic systems ranging from residential rooftops to utility-scale arrays, including battery storage, carport, and off-grid configurations. It also provides electric vehicle charger installation for homes and businesses, backup power solutions such as battery backup and generators, and a full range of electrical services covering residential wiring, commercial wiring, underground wiring, and electrical excavation for both single-phase and three-phase systems.

JL Solar serves homeowners, commercial businesses, non-profit organizations, and utility-scale developers across the Midwest. Its project portfolio includes solar installations for private residences, companies seeking to reduce energy costs, non-profits pursuing sustainability goals, and large-scale solar farms.

The firm emphasizes a client-centered approach grounded in safety, integrity, and professionalism. From initial consultation through post-installation support, the team aims to deliver a seamless experience, treating each project with the care of a family business and leveraging the deep technical expertise of its master electrician.
